Name: JP's Debris Is In The Air
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][b][i][u]Debris Is In The Air[/u][/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]


[font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]And after a long time, the original “Debris Is In The Air” -the idea that started it all- has finally come to fruition. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[font=Georgia][b][i][size=5][color=#00ffff][u]Other DIITA Mods:[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/55256]DIITA[/url][/size]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38489][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/38489]DIITA - Night Lights[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41179]DIITA - Wildlife[/url][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45051]DIITA - Ambient Lights[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41184]DIITA - Eternal Lights[/url][/size][/font]


[font=Georgia][size=4][b]This mod adds new visual effects to the valley's weather (THESE ARE NOT NEW WEATHER TYPES), more movement patterns for the leaves, rain that can change throughout the day, fog, dew, and leaves on the ground.[/b][/size][/font]


[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Dynamic Weather & Wind Simulation[/size][/b][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Realistic Wind Patterns[/b]: 10 distinct atmospheric patterns (ranging from dead calm and gentle breezes to thermal updrafts, wind gusts, crosswinds, and gale-force winds).[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Dust Devils / Leaf Whirlwinds[/b]: Spiral air vortices that pull in and swirl airborne leaves during turbulent and swirling wind days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Leaves Everywhere[/b]: Seasonally varied air particles (spring flower petals, vibrant summer leaves, golden-red autumn foliage, and light winter flurry flakes).[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/G2szSmqJ/DIITA-Deb4.gif[/img][/font]

[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Dynamic Rain Puddles[/size][/b][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Organic Accumulation[/b]: Puddles form progressively during rain based on storm intensity (from light drizzles to downpours) and leave residual shallow pools on the morning following a rainy day.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Time-of-Day Lighting / Color Shifts[/b]: Puddle water reflections seamlessly transition between dawn (6:00 AM), bright afternoon (2:00 PM), and deep nighttime (10:00 PM), complete with green-tinted reflections during Green Rain.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Raindrop Ripples[/b]: Water droplets create expanding concentric ripples across puddles, scaling in count and frequency with active rainfall density.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Interactive Footsteps[/b]: Players, pets, and NPCs splash water and generate ripples when walking over puddles. Tilling a tile with a hoe permanently clears the puddle.[/font]

[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/wvsFbj0Q/DIITA-Deb3.gif[/img][/font]

[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Leaf Mounds & Walkable Leaf Mats[/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Organic Bell-Shaped Mounds[/b]: Soft, dense piles of fallen leaves gather on calm, windless days (and fluffy snowdrifts during winter).[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Kick & Scatter Physics[/b]: Running through a pile rustles with custom audio and sends leaves gliding forward in your movement direction. In winter, snow puffs kick up and settle back onto the ground.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Walkable Fallen Leaf Mats[/b]: Wide patches of fallen leaves on the ground that replace regular footstep sounds with dry, satisfying leaf-crunching cues.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Leaves Drifting on Water[/b]: Floating leaves rest on rivers and ponds, gently drifting with water currents and wind drift before fading away naturally without clipping onto dry shores or building tiles.[/font]

[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fyn54QPn/DIITA-Deb6.gif[/img][/font]

[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Volumetric 2.5D Fog & Morning Dew[/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Morning Dew[/b]: Glistening water droplets condense across lawn grass at dawn (6:00 AM to 10:30 AM), featuring specular glints and natural sun evaporation.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Trampling Dew Sprays[/b]: Walking, running, or riding a horse through dewy grass blades flings micro-water droplets into the air.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Late Fall Frost[/b]: During late autumn (Fall 22–28), morning dew transforms into frosty white ice crystals.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Ground & Canopy Fog[/b]: Organically rendered procedural fog banks that drift across the valley without static PNG tiling artifacts.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]2.5D Mid-Body Submersion[/b]: Walking into low fog softly envelops characters' legs and waistlines in volumetric ground mist while keeping hats, hair, and chests crisp and clean above.[/font]

[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/cH8T5LX9/DIITA-Deb5.gif[/img][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3wqnBvC1/DIITA-Deb1.gif[/img][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/s2Lwch9h/DIITA-Deb2.gif[/img][/font]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Once again, these aren't new weather conditions; they're simply visual effects for the game that use the existing weather conditions. I'm not sure if they'll work well with mods that add weather conditions. All effects can be configured using GMCM.[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]


[font=Georgia][i][b][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/b][/i]
[b][size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size][/b][/font]
